view_issues: Inconsistent counts: Summary/intro give 73 tested for IgM (1.4%), results and Table 2 give 68 (1.5%); text says 32 mpox-vaccinated (22+10) but Discussion says 16% with 54% IgG; Table 2 labels 'Age ≤50' vs text '<50'; IgG 2/80 reported as 2.5% and 3%.
